metadata.title: 天然っぽく言える！？🇯🇵✨「ちょっと…」で会話が伸びる！
metadata.description: Ever hear “chotto…” and wonder how Japanese people sound so natural? In this quick Reel, you’ll learn practical ways to use 「ちょっと」—from softening requests to adding friendly context—so you can speak with confidence. Save this reel for later and practice it before your next conversation! Comment your favorite「ちょっと」phrase below, and follow Velocity Japanese for daily lessons in vocabulary, pronunciation, kanji, and culture. #japanese #learnjapanese #japaneselanguage #nihongo #japanesesson #velocityjapanese #kanji #japanesevocabulary #dailyjapanese #speakjapanese #studyjapanese #japantravel
